notes.title: Tako no Himitsu new trailer update!
notes.content:
Bonsoir,

I hope you've all been doing well. We are hard at work with the team on the development of Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets. We are almost[b] done with the first act of the game[/b], there is still a lot of content to be made, but we still wanted to give you a new glimpse of our game world. We also have a lot of progress on the soundtrack, including a [b]new battle track by Motoi Sakuraba[/b], the composer behind Golden Sun, the Tales of series, Dark Soul and Star Ocean!

[previewyoutube=VZdkMaBJuNw;full][/previewyoutube]

This trailer was part of two indie game showcases, so please go check the other games and wishlist them as well:

- AG French Direct
[previewyoutube=_mJfGPdssCU;full][/previewyoutube]

- Indie Quest
[previewyoutube=QAanpHTfrAw;full][/previewyoutube]

Since our last update, we also worked and released an other game, [b]Wednesdays[/b], so please check it out: [url=store.steampowered.com/app/2747770/Wednesdays/]store.steampowered.com/app/2747770/Wednesdays/[/url]

notes.title: Updated Demo Out Now! New boss and latin Spanish localization available!
notes.content:
Hello all, 

Quick update here as we just patched the game Kickstarter demo!

Firstly, a huge thank you to the over 7500 players who have already downloaded the demo. I hope you enjoyed it!  Since returning from my trip to Japan, we have been working tirelessly to finish the updated version of the demo, and I’m happy to say: it’s done!

You can find the updated demo on Steam right now ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3068030/Tako_no_Himitsu_Ocean_of_Secrets__Kickstarter_Demo/]link[/url]). 
In addition to the 1:30 hours of base content it already featured, you can now enjoy a brand new boss fight, updated puzzles, updated maps, and smaller general quality-of-life improvements. We also now have a latin spanish translation thanks to our friend Genow! Thank you to everyone who provided feedback on the demo; it was super helpful!

We have a few stretchgoals left to make the game even better.

By the way, now you can leave reviews to the demo which can help us getting more players, so don't forget to do it if you played it!

Have a great day!

notes.title: It's rare for a pixel art throwback to really wow me these days, but a hybrid action-JRPG where you collect magical octopus friends to cast spells might just fit the bill
notes.content: There are so many indie throwbacks to old Nintendo consoles these days, it takes a lot of juice for one to really catch my eye, but Game Boy Advance-style RPG Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets (previously reported on by Rock Paper Shotgun) looks like it has the right stuff. Tako no Himitsu (literally "Secret of the Octopus") has particularly gorgeous art, as well as soundtrack contributions from GBA and SNES vets Motoi Sakuraba (Golden Sun, Dark Souls) and Masanori Hikichi (Terranigma, Danganropa 2)... Read more.

notes.title: New full game trailer, and early demo available now!
notes.content:
Hello from Deneos! 

We’re super excited to show the brand new trailer for Tako no Himitsu, and to announce that the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1373467035/tako-no-himitsu-ocean-of-secrets?ref=7jebxe]Kickstarter[/url] is live today!

Tako no Himitsu is an action JRPG made as a tribute to GBA classics - you can expect puzzles, party systems and a narrative that explores each character’s story and the world around them.

[previewyoutube=CPNuTy0fmh0;full][/previewyoutube]

Alongside the launching of our Kickstarter campaign today, we’re excited to share an early demo of Tako no Himitsu - there’s over an hour of gameplay for you to enjoy, giving you plenty of time to explore some of the world and meet some of the characters!

As this is an early demo, there may be some bug and fixes that we’ll roll out (boss improvements are already on the list). If you encounter any bugs, or would just like to give feedback, you can join our Discord [url=https://discord.com/invite/X5rTjHxNe2]here[/url].

And of course, wishlist Tako no Himitsu now! It helps us out more than you know, and as a small team every bit of support means the world to us.

notes.title: Introducing Tako no Himitsu - a narrative action RPG!
notes.content:
Hello from Deneos! We’re super excited to announce our brand-new game, Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets, is coming to Kickstarter this summer.

Tako no Himitsu is an action RPG that’s been described as Golden Sun meets Illusion of Gaia. Made as a tribute to the Game Boy Advance era of gaming, play in a world centuries on from the events of Save me Mr Tako! where octopuses have been erased from history.

Uncover the story of six playable characters and the vast world they inhabit. Explore, solve puzzles and best your enemies in combat to learn the long forgotten truth and save the world.

[previewyoutube=1OSjg_zyKb8;full][/previewyoutube]

There’s plenty to uncover in Tako no Himitsu, and we’re looking forward to bringing you an exciting new adventure. We’re currently gearing up for a Kickstarter campaign this summer to help us in completing the game, so make sure [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1373467035/tako-no-himitsu-ocean-of-secrets]you visit our page[/url] and sign up to be notified when it goes live! Don’t forget to [url=https://twitter.com/DeneosGames]visit our Twitter page[/url] as well for news, updates and more.

And of course, wishlist Tako no Himitsu now! It helps us out more than you know, and as a small team every bit of support means the world to us.
